description: The file is the main application component for a Tic Tac Toe game implemented using React Native. It manages game state, user interactions, visual rendering of the game board, input handling, animations, and UI elements like player indicators and reset controls.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component implementing the Tic Tac Toe game, managing game state, animations, and UI rendering.

methods.name: PlayerPill
methods.description: Component representing the player's indicator pill with active state and color.

methods.name: Board
methods.description: Component rendering the 3x3 game grid with cells, lines, and highlighting for winning lines.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: Component representing a single cell in the game grid, handling touch feedback and displaying 'X' or 'O'.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: Component for rendering a styled button with different variants.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Function to determine if there's a winner in the current board state.

methods.name: getWinningLine
methods.description: Function to identify which line makes up the winning combination.
